capabilities: Create self-contained .layer database files with 16 column types
View and edit records as tables and kanban-style boards
Compute values with formulas, relations, lookups, backlinks and rollups
Filter, sort, total and undo changes in table and board views
Edit tables from AI assistants through an MCP server
disambiguation: Records live in self-contained .layer JSON files, not in queries over existing vault notes.
extras: README warns that much of the code is AI-generated and advises backing up the vault before first use; .layer files are plain JSON and remain readable by hand.
problem: Obsidian has no way to keep structured, typed records with computed columns in one self-contained file independent of the vault's folder structure.

relations.evidence: With BRAT — install BRAT, then run BRAT → Add beta plugin and enter CryingObsidian-CO/obsidian-layer-base.
paste the block into the client's config file (claude_desktop_config.json for Claude Desktop) and restart it.

summary: Self-contained .layer database files that render as tables or boards, with 16 column types, formulas, relations, lookups and rollups.
